limits: Evaluator-only annotation-conditioned capacity: witnesses must never enter runtime selection or answer packets.

The baseline is preserved, including known same-day future-stamped text; this check validates eligible new-source bundles and does not certify baseline temporal cleanliness.
No new embeddings, model answers, paid calls, runtime candidate packets, or answer accuracy measurements.
